items.title: How the cost of an immutable update scales with list size
items.description: L3's toggleItemDone/updateItemQty pattern rebuilds the whole array with map() on every update — even though only one item actually changed. This models the measured cost of that pattern (a real Node benchmark of the exact map()-based copy, not a made-up formula) as the list grows. A 16.6ms line marks a single 60fps frame budget, so you can see roughly where a naive full-array copy on every keystroke would start to compete with everything else the frame has to do.
